overview: PK Worker Droid is a worker droid built by Publictechnic, documented across Andor · Rogue One · Clone Wars. Small worker droids deployed in factories, mines, and Death Star construction crews—anonymous labor that built Imperial megaprojects.

PK worker droids perform repetitive factory and construction tasks on Imperial megaprojects. Technicians praise PK Worker Droid's modular worker droid subsystems: field-replaceable limbs, redundant processors, and firmware packages that slicers and mechanics exploit in scrap yards centuries after initial rollout.
